description: This file contains an abstract class 'CacheCollector' implementing cache collection logic for Drupal, including cache management, lazy loading, invalidation, and cache persistence mechanisms.

classes.name: CacheCollector
classes.description: An abstract class providing cache collection, lazy loading, invalidation, and persistence functionalities for Drupal's caching system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the CacheCollector with cache ID, cache backend, lock backend, and optional tags.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the cache storage.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value by key, loading cache if necessary, or resolves cache miss.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a value for a key in the cache storage and invalidates cache.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a key from cache storage and marks it for removal.

methods.name: persist
methods.description: Flags a key to be persisted to the cache.

methods.name: resolveCacheMiss
methods.description: Abstract method to resolve cache miss for a key.

methods.name: updateCache
methods.description: Writes the current cache data to persistent cache, with locking and invalidation handling.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the cache storage and related state.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the cache and invalidates tags or deletes cache by ID.

methods.name: destruct
methods.description: Ensures cache is updated upon object destruction.

methods.name: lazyLoadCache
methods.description: Loads cache data if not already loaded.

methods.name: invalidateCache
methods.description: Invalidates the cache to ensure immediate visibility of deletions.
